label: Ridgeline Native Full Audit
changes: Walks whose map name is written differently from DOC's stay drawn: the map's 'Mt Iron Track' is DOC's 'Mount Iron Track' (no DOC line), so the walk's line built from the map's tracks of DOC's name found nothing and replaced the tapped track's line with none. Map tracks are matched by name as labels are (Mt/Mount, generic words), the tapped map name is used too, and each piece is used once.

Photos in DOC's page text (walks, legs, huts) are shown in place with DOC's caption and credit ('Brewster Track is very steep and unformed… Image: Alice Milne'), loaded when a section is opened and sized to the screen; 'See larger' links and icons are left out, and captions are not read as directions, legs or starts.

Huts on a walk are those DOC's page names in full, when it names any: the Greenstone and Caples tracks list Mid Caples, McKellar and Greenstone huts, not Slip Flat Hut (near the Greenstone Track; the page names only Slip Flat, the clearing). DOC's asset codes are removed from hut names for matching and display ('T3: South Ohau Hut', 'Mintaro Hut (2021)', 'Top Crooked Hut 3PM', 'Pinnacles Hut (Mt Somers Track)'); old and historic huts ('Julia Hut (Old 1958)') stay distinct.
dataChecks: Hut survey over DOC walk pages with lines (huts-survey.txt): 42 walks have a nearby DOC hut their page does not name (old or historic huts beside the current ones, huts of neighbouring walks); all named huts are kept. Map names checked at Mount Iron: 'Mt Iron Track'. Brewster Track page: 10 photos with captions.
